distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) and Smith et al. (2020) both support occurrence in Fujian. Smith et al. (2020) includes locality evidence from Shaowu, Tachulan.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) reports Cinnamomum austrosinense and Cinnamomum camphora. Smith et al. (2020) reports Cinnamomum at genus level, consistent with the baseline evidence.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Anisandrus klapperichi (Schedl, 1955).

taxonomic_history.name: Anisandrus klapperichi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 黄复生等 (2015) used Terminalinus klapperichi; this source-specific combination is retained as provenance without changing the stable VSN.
